rows.reference: Serum 2 installs alongside Serum 1 and does not automatically replace existing projects.
rows.lumus: Independent lumus-hybrid-synth identity and lumus namespace; Aether remains wavetable-synth.

rows.reference: Three main oscillator slots A-C plus dedicated sub and noise.
rows.lumus: Schema v5 has a fixed, validated A/B/C rack with independent sample/granular ownership and bounded simultaneous Wavetable/Sample/Granular selection in every slot.

rows.reference: Wavetable, multisample, sample, granular, and spectral modes are selectable in main oscillator slots.
rows.lumus: Wavetable, sample, and granular playback are verified independently in A-C. Multisample mapping exists inside Sample but is not a distinct rack mode; spectral remains paused.

rows.reference: Dual warps and smooth wavetable interpolation.
rows.lumus: Two serial runtime warp stages and immutable timbral-frame interpolation exist in the inherited renderer.

rows.reference: Each oscillator/filter can target Filter 1/2 mix, Main, Direct, None, and Bus 1/2 sends.
rows.lumus: A/B/C wavetable and sample sources independently target the shared filter, Filter 1, Filter 2, Direct, or None while retaining two source sends.

rows.reference: Main plus two routable FX busses.
rows.lumus: Inherits two source FX sends and Beat-owned bus infrastructure; Lumus-specific graph contract is not yet frozen.

rows.reference: Configurable envelopes/LFOs and broad modulation assignment.
rows.lumus: Inherits four envelopes, ten LFO slots, eight macros, performance/MPE sources, deterministic route ordering, and native/browser modulation of Slot C position, fine, level, pan, detune, and spread.

rows.reference: Integrated arpeggiator and MIDI clip sequencer with key, scale, and swing context.
rows.lumus: No synth-owned arpeggiator or clip sequencer.

rows.reference: Serum 1 presets load in Serum 2, while Serum 2 presets do not load in Serum 1.
rows.lumus: No implicit migration. A future explicit one-way Aether-to-Lumus conversion must clone data and preserve the original Aether instrument.

rows.reference: Official guidance states equivalent Serum 1 patches should use the same or less CPU in Serum 2.
rows.lumus: Foundation output is bit-identical to Aether and must not regress Aether or exceed its equivalent-patch budget without a documented reason.
